fact: GPE's annual progress report for 31 July 2024 to 30 July 2025 says the EMIS Policy was validated and finalised and goes to Cabinet, the Unique Learner ID terms of reference were finalised with procurement under way, and the ULID is planned for piloting in four districts, for learners in P1 to P4.
title: System Transformation Grant Annual Progress Report Template for Projects (Sierra Leone, GPE0000948)
publisher: Global Partnership for Education / UNICEF as grant agent
